summary: Persist and validate the latest recommendation in repo-local .go
description: Add supported recommendation create/status state so a compact execution brief survives chat loss before it becomes tasks.
acceptance: A supported CLI command writes one validated pending recommendation under .go and validate inspects it.
The stored record contains compact brief, source hash/reference, authority state, and creation time without full chat prose.
Invalid or tampered recommendations fail before state mutation.
Explicit read-only advice can be represented without creating durable state.

evidence.summary: RED: recommendation tests failed because no supported recommendation command or state existed. GREEN: recommendation create/status now validates execution briefs, persists compact .go/recommendations/pending.json with authority/time/hash/source, validates it during repo validation, rejects tampered hashes before writes, and supports --read-only with zero .go mutation; focused 2 tests passed. Self-reflect: no additional durable agent/process improvement needed; the planned supported state boundary replaces the prior ad-hoc gap.
